hongyacave.name: Hongya Cave (Hongyadong)
hongyacave.price_text: Free to enter the complex; food and drinks extra
hongyacave.hours: Stalls roughly 10:00–23:00; lights on after dark
hongyacave.tip: Come after dark for the lit-up stilt houses, and view them from Qiansimen Bridge instead of standing in the crowd.

ciqikou.name: Ciqikou Ancient Town
ciqikou.price_text: Free to walk; snacks and teahouses cost extra
ciqikou.hours: Streets open all day; shops roughly 09:00–21:00
ciqikou.tip: Go early morning to see the lanes without crowds, and try the local mahua (fried dough twists).

dazu.name: Dazu Rock Carvings
dazu.price_text: Ticketed; price varies by site — check on the day
dazu.tip: It is a long day trip from the city, so go with a tour or early train and allow most of a day.

liziba.name: Liziba Station (monorail through a building)
liziba.tip: Ride Line 2 through the building, then watch trains from the viewing platform outside.

landsea.name: Chongqing International Land-Sea Center
landsea.price_text: Observation deck ticketed — check on the day
landsea.hours: Check on the day; evening slots popular
landsea.tip: Book a sunset slot for river and skyline views, and check the weather before you go.

fantawild.name: Fantawild Adventure (Chongqing)
fantawild.price_text: Day ticket; price varies by season — check on the day
fantawild.tip: A full-day theme park outside the centre, so plan transport and go on a weekday if you can.

jialing.name: Jialing River waterfront
jialing.tip: Walk the riverside path near Hongya Cave at dusk for the best skyline reflections.

cablecar.name: Yangtze River Cableway
cablecar.price_text: One-way ticket; price varies — check on the day
cablecar.tip: Ride one way across the Yangtze for city views, and queue early or late to avoid the worst lines.

cikoumarket.name: Chongqing hotpot dinner
cikoumarket.price_text: ≈ CNY 80–150 per person; varies by restaurant
cikoumarket.tip: Order mild (weiwēi) if you are new to the numbing peppercorn heat, and dip in oil and garlic.

nanshan.name: Nanshan viewpoint (One Tree)
nanshan.price_text: Small entry fee at some viewpoints — check on the day
nanshan.tip: Come at night for the full city skyline across the rivers; bring a jacket in winter.

cikouwalk.name: Shancheng Lane old-town walk
cikouwalk.hours: Open all day; livelier in the evening
cikouwalk.tip: Walk the stepped lanes to feel the hilly city, and wear shoes with grip.

cruise.name: Two Rivers night cruise
cruise.price_text: ≈ CNY 100–200 depending on boat — check on the day
cruise.tip: Book a boat with an open deck and arrive early for a good spot on the rail.

market.name: Local food street (xiaochi) snack crawl
market.tip: Try xiaomian (spicy noodles) and suanlafen, and pay by phone or small cash.

museum.name: Three Gorges Museum
museum.price_text: Free with ID; some shows extra
museum.tip: Good rainy-day stop to learn the river and dam history before a cruise.

peoplepark.name: People's Park teahouse
peoplepark.tip: Sit with locals over tea in the morning and watch the city slow down.

escalator.name: Hongyadong to Jiefangbei stair walk
escalator.tip: Climb the stairs between the river and the shopping district to understand the city's levels.
